page_title: EVE 0-0 CHE | Everton v Chelsea 22/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
88' Beto (Everton) has tested the patience of referee Chris Kavanagh and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
87' 5:12 – the total goal attempt statistics.
86' Orel Mangala (Everton) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Robert Sanchez has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
84' Some neat passing and movement from Chelsea as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
82' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
81' Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
78' Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul after Idrissa Gueye (Everton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
76' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Noni Madueke (Chelsea) comes onto the pitch so that Pedro Neto can be given a rest.
75' That will be all from Nicolas Jackson who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea).
74' Substitution. Jesper Lindstrom (Everton) on for Jack Harrison.
73' Sean Dyche decides to make a substitution. Ashley Young will be replaced by Seamus Coleman (Everton).
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Beto (Everton) is replacing Dominic Calvert-Lewin.
73' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
72' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
70' 3:11 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
68' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
67' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
66' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
66' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
66' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.

63' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for an infringement. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Chelsea.

62' That didn't go as planned! Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Jordan Pickford, who easily kept it out.
60' Chelsea take a short corner kick.
60' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) attempts to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but his effort fails to reach the goal.
57' What was Ashley Young (Everton) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
56' Chelsea keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
53' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and signals a foul after Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) brought his opponent down.
52' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sends it out of play.
50' Jack Harrison (Everton) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Robert Sanchez makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
49' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robert Sanchez, who smothers the ball.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' The referee gives a yellow card to Jordan Pickford (Everton) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' James Tarkowski (Everton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Chris Kavanagh saw the whole situation.
43' 2:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
41' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) commits a foul and Chris Kavanagh immediately signals a free kick.
40' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
38' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
38' Orel Mangala (Everton) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Robert Sanchez easily deals with the threat.
37' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. James Tarkowski (Everton) commits a foul after dangerous play.
34' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and it's Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
32' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) heads on.
32' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
31' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) picks up the rebound and shoots. The goalkeeper was ready and denies his effort with a fine save.
31' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) rises high to connect with the ball inside the six-yard box from the corner kick, but his decent header only hits the right post and ricochets away!
31' The ball is out of play. Chelsea will have a chance to score from a corner.
31' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Jordan Pickford easily deals with the threat.
29' The foul by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) was seen by Chris Kavanagh who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
26' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is furious with himself. He is quickest to the rebound near the penalty spot, but his header goes well over the crossbar!

26' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
25' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:3.
23' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
22' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
19' Ashley Young (Everton) brings his opponent down. Chris Kavanagh has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Ashley Young (Everton) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Robert Sanchez to dive and make a save.
16' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul after Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) hacks down one of his opponents.
15' The linesman raises his flag. Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is adjudged offside.
15' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton).
14' Chelsea are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
11' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
9' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) sends a chip pass into the box, but Robert Sanchez is quickest to intercept the ball.
9' Everton are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
6' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
4' Jack Harrison (Everton) commits a foul during an attacking move.
3' Fine play by Cole Palmer (Chelsea) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles past the right post.
2' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) was too forceful with his tackle and Chris Kavanagh interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
2' The ball is cleared after Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Everton will have the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh is the one to supervise the game today.
